unlocked_speed_max.description: Maximum value accepted by the unlocked simulation speed command.

dumping_pf_guard_searches_per_truck_per_.description: Maximum dumping-destination searches allowed for one truck between path-finding simulation updates. 0 disables this limit.

dumping_pf_guard_searches_total_per_tick.description: Maximum dumping-destination searches allowed in total between path-finding simulation updates. 0 disables this limit.
